summary: Implementation plan for the BananaBomb Professional Game UI/UX and 3D Floating Hands Overhaul. Covers the Warm Charcoal & Amber Tactical Briefcase visual identity, decluttered mobile-first game lobby with a dedicated header-triggered Reference & Pre-Round Checklist sheet, compact high-contrast gameplay HUDs, role-tailored Operator/Observer/Manual-holder interfaces, wrist-only floating 3D gloved monkey hands with armless teammate torsos and positive-scale chirality, and automated sightline/geometry/accessibility verification.
